title.narrative: Strengthening Community Resilience through Early Actions for Anticipated Cyclones in Cox's Bazar District, Bangladesh

description.narrative: Objective of the project: To strengthen the resilience of 2000 vulnerable households in Cox's Bazar & Teknaf Upazila by implementing anticipatory actions aimed at minimizing disaster-induced losses from cyclones through multi-purpose cash grants (MPCG), mobility support, WASH facilities, and shelter assistance.
The project aim to reach a total of 2000 HHs with approximately 8520 individuals

The project targets 1,050 direct and 1,000 indirect households in four cyclone-prone unions of Cox’s Bazar Sadar and Teknaf Upazilas. It aims to reduce asset loss, enhance preparedness, and improve post-cyclone recovery through a coordinated, multi-sector approach. The main intervention is the distribution of unconditional Multi-Purpose Cash Grants (MPCG), supplemented with early action measures in WASH, shelter, mobility, protection, and information dissemination.
